meta.title: Buyer requests re-evaluation of selected line items
gaps: That technical evaluators must take action after the request
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: That technical evaluators must take action after the request

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and a vendor response available for evaluation.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the re-evaluation request is made.

args.goal: As the buyer, open Settings, select Request for Re-Evaluation, enter a reason, select the requested line items under Select Line Items, send the request, and stop when the selected line items show Re-evaluation Requested.

steps.note: Perform the re-evaluation request flow that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Verify the requested line items display the expected re-evaluation status.
